about_the_game:
Introduction

Fantasy Skycity is a 3D simulation management game developed with Unreal Engine 5. In the game, you will manage a sky city, construct various buildings, and receive visiting tourists and adventurers through airships, allowing them to live and grow in your city.

Hundreds of Buildings

The game offers hundreds of different buildings, most of which have unique technologies. As you use them or increase the number of visitors, more forms will be unlocked, while providing you with substantial profits.

Cultivate Adventurers

You can make the city more prosperous by recruiting adventurers. They will travel through the city's portal to explore various floating islands. Meanwhile, build facilities, stock goods, and let them consume and live in your city. You can also establish guilds for them and issue daily tasks to boost their enthusiasm. (Most adventurers do not rely on your cultivation—they will buy suitable equipment, go out to fight monsters, level up, and grow stronger, so they can have more money to spend in your city.)

Unique AI

Each adventurer has a distinct personality. They form friendships, chat and discuss in the adventurers' exclusive channel, share opinions on the city's future development, and celebrate happily when your city thrives.

Sky Ecology

The sky is filled with countless floating islands, each with unique challenges and monsters. You can customize adventure areas for adventurers according to your preferences, artificially increase difficulties to help them grow rapidly, and dispatch them to collect various resources for you, accelerating city construction. Occasionally, you will encounter airships of different types in the sky, which will bring new tourists and adventurers. You can trade with them to obtain huge profits.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD or Intel, 3 GHz (AMD A10 7850K, Intel i3-2000)
  • Graphics: AMD/NVIDIA dedicated GPU, 4GB dedicated VRAM (Radeon R9 280, Geforce GTX 960)
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
